subject: general
question:
**Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a spelling error. Select the option that rectifies the error.**

Earth has seen many drastic changes in its climate in the resent past.
solution: The correct answer is **'resent'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Option 3 "recent**" is the correct spelling to be used here. • The correct spelling of the word is "**recent**" instead of "**resent**". • **Recent** means "**having happened, begun, or been done not long ago or not long before"** whereas **resent** means "**feel bitterness or indignation at (a circumstance, action, or person)**" • Therefore, the sentence should be written as "**Earth has seen many drastic changes in its climate in the recent past.**" • So, **option 3** is the correct choice to rectify the spelling error in the given sentence. Thus, ***option 3*** is the correct answer. **Correct sentence**__: *Earth has seen many drastic changes in its climate in the **recent** past.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • **Recent** का अर्थ है "**होना, शुरू होना, या बहुत पहले या बहुत पहले नहीं किया गया**" जबकि **resent** का अर्थ है "**कटुता या आक्रोश महसूस करना (एक परिस्थिति, क्रिया या व्यक्ति)**" 8b:T1046, The correct answer is '**disorganise**'.
